title: 低岩包撑起
description: 分层剪纸展示低矮宽岩包上的撑起动作，主脚和另一支撑点明确。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration depicts a fictional adult practicing a controlled mantle onto a broad low bouldering volume. The volume top is only knee height above the continuous padded floor; one foot stands on its generous surface, the other remains on a positive wall foothold, and the hands press a rounded upper edge. The torso rises through the supporting leg without an abrupt jump or exposed top-out. Show the full figure from an oblique medium-wide angle with all contacts and the empty landing visible. Use textured olive paper, cream wall layers, and ochre shadows. Clothing is opaque. Exclude lettering, brands, high ledges, strained poses, and cliff exposure.
